is_anopheles.evidence: The study identifies Anopheles gambiae s.s., Anopheles pharoensis, and Anopheles funestus (page 4, Entomology section).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports the detection of the West African kdr mutation (L1014F) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 3, Mosquito processing; page 4, Entomology section).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports the kdr genotype counts for Anopheles gambiae s.s.: 95.2% homozygous resistant (RR) and 4.8% heterozygous resistant (RS) out of 21 samples (page 4, Entomology section).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Mpraeso, Kwahu-South district, Ghana (page 2, Study sites and population).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original cross-sectional study (page 2, Study design and participant selection).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Mpraeso, Kwahu-South district, Eastern Region, Ghana, and specifies six clusters (page 2, Study sites and population).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between October and December 2013 (page 2, Study design and participant selection).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific cross-sectional survey conducted in 2013.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype frequencies and sample sizes, are provided in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study investigated asymptomatic malaria in humans and vector characteristics in Mpraeso, Ghana, in 2013. It identified Anopheles gambiae s.s. as the primary vector and genotyped the L1014F kdr mutation, finding high levels of resistance.
